question: calculate 2023 ANC coverage rate minus 2021 rate in percentage points for Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: WITH data_2021 AS (SELECT district, anc4_completed AS anc4_completed_2021, pregnancies_registered AS pregnancies_registered_2021 FROM anc_visits WHERE year = 2021 AND district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')), data_2023 AS (SELECT district, anc4_completed AS anc4_completed_2023, pregnancies_registered AS pregnancies_registered_2023 FROM anc_visits WHERE year = 2023 AND district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')) SELECT d1.district, (d1.anc4_completed_2023 * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(d1.pregnancies_registered_2023, 0), 0), 0)) - (d1.anc4_completed_2021 * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(d1.pregnancies_registered_2021, 0), 0), 0)) AS percentage_point_change FROM data_2021 AS d1 JOIN data_2023 AS d2 ON d1.district = d2.district
